calls.reason: The packet has no independent test of the reflexive prompt on DALL-E Mini or DALL-E from June 2022. The only related study is a later DALL-E 2 paper that Marcus co-wrote.

Li et al. found entity-state representations that could be queried, though they were error-prone, and the chess study showed accurate state tracking in one narrow domain. The evidence is mixed and 'reliable use' has no defined bar.
This is a hedged causal suggestion. The only evidence is the scaling-laws paper, which shows that prediction research existed but documents nothing about displacing theory work.
Lialin et al. found zero-shot composition failures, but GPT-3 with least-to-most prompting reached 99.7% on SCAN. The evidence is mixed and 'sidestep' is vague.
The DALL-E 2 paper shows binding trouble on a two-cube prompt, but with the colors reversed. No sampled frequency backs the 'as likely as not' rate.

TruthfulQA shows GPT-3 gave many false answers, but InstructGPT roughly halved its made-up content and WebGPT reduced falsehoods. The causal mechanism and the 'not so remediable' part remain unsettled.
